remarks:
Welcome to 771 Robin Road, where comfortable one-level living meets modern updates and inviting spaces! This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-full-bath ranch offers a versatile layout with the convenience of single-story living.

The updated kitchen features crisp white cabinetry and a center island, while the spacious family room impresses with a cathedral ceiling and sliding glass doors leading to the deck and fully fenced backyard, complete with a hot tub that's included in the sale! The partially finished basement provides additional living and entertaining space with a cozy gas fireplace, generous storage, and a dedicated laundry area. Both full bathrooms have been updated, and a newer driveway, just two years old, along with a 2.5-car attached garage, adds to the home's appeal.

Enjoy the added benefits of the Audubon community, offering residents access to a seasonal swimming pool, tennis and basketball courts, playgrounds, scenic walking and biking trails, and beautiful green spaces. Located in the highly sought-after Williamsville School District, this home offers convenient access to I-990 and I-290, making travel throughout Western New York a breeze. Shopping, dining, and everyday amenities are just minutes away!

Whether you're purchasing your first home, looking to downsize, or simply appreciate the ease of ranch-style living, this home offers comfort, convenience, and flexibility.

**Showings begin at the open house on Saturday, October 17th, from 11 AM to 1 PM, with a second open house Sunday, October 18th, from 11 AM to 1 PM. All offers are due Wednesday, October 21st, by 5 PM and will be reviewed at that time.**
